builds.title: Thanoi racial class 5, ice-channel sentry
builds.difficulty: CR 2 per racial table. ECL 5 with 3 racial Hit Dice and level adjustment +2.
traits: BAB +3. Grapple +8. Saves Fort +5, Ref +5, Will +2. Touch AC 12, flat-footed AC 14. Wears no armor.
Power Attack and Weapon Focus (club). Immune to cold. Fire deals 50% extra damage.

Great Breath allows 30 minutes underwater before the first Constitution check. As a creature with a swim speed, Orruk can take 10 on Swim checks even under pressure. The printed +8 Swim bonus is counted once.
actions: Club +9 melee, 1d6+5 bludgeoning. Throw at +6 ranged before range penalties, 1d6+5 bludgeoning. Range increment 10 ft., maximum range 50 ft.
Tusks +8 melee, 2d4+5 piercing. Club and tusks full attack uses club +9 for 1d6+5 and tusks +3 for 2d4+2.
Power Attack allows subtracting up to 3 from all melee attack rolls to add the same amount to melee damage until his next turn, including the natural tusk attack.
builds.tactics: Orruk heads into the channel when the surface path crowds. If cornered on shore, he starts with the club and adds his tusks when he can stand and full attack.

builds.title: Ursoi racial class 7, crossing guide
builds.difficulty: CR 4 per racial table. ECL 7 with 5 racial Hit Dice and level adjustment +2.
traits: BAB +5. Grapple +16. Saves Fort +6, Ref +6, Will +7. Touch AC 11, flat-footed AC 13. Natural armor +4, size −1, Dexterity +2.
10-ft. space and reach. Cold resistance 10. Power Attack and Track. He can locate a scent’s direction as a move action and pinpoint a source within 5 ft.
Scent radius is 20 ft. per the racial table, 40 ft. upwind and 10 ft. downwind for ordinary scents.
actions: Claw +11 melee, 1d6+7 slashing. Full attack with two claws +11 each for 1d6+7 and a secondary bite +6 for 1d8+3 piercing.

Improved Grab on a claw hit against Medium or smaller. Make the +16 grapple check without a touch attack. He can use a one-claw hold and stay outside the grapple by taking −20 on grapple checks, for a modifier of −4. Successful grapple checks in later rounds deal claw damage.
Power Attack allows subtracting up to 5 from melee attack rolls to add the same amount to natural weapon damage until his next turn.
builds.tactics: Saltlistener stands between the travelers and the loose ice. He holds a single attacker when he can so his charges have time to back away.

builds.title: Baaz draconian with 2 racial Hit Dice and Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: CR 3 estimated from the printed Baaz CR 2 plus one associated fighter level. ECL 4 with level adjustment +1.
builds.speed: 30 ft., glide 4 ft. horizontally per foot fallen
traits: BAB +3. Grapple +6. Saves Fort +8, Ref +4, Will +3. Touch AC 11, flat-footed AC 17. Chain shirt +4, light wooden shield +1, natural armor +2 and Dexterity +1. Armor check penalty −3.
Weapon Focus (longsword), Power Attack, Improved Initiative, Run. Spell resistance 9. Immune to sleep, paralysis and disease.
Glide negates falling damage. Inspired by Dragons grants +1 morale to attacks and saves if a dragon commander is visible or he enters battle under one. No commander is present in this encounter.
actions: Longsword +7 melee, 1d8+3 slashing, 19–20/×2. Shield stays equipped. On a full attack he can add a secondary bite +1 melee for 1d4+1 piercing.
With both hands free, full attack with two claws +6 each, 1d4+3 slashing, and secondary bite +1, 1d4+1 piercing.
Death Throes petrifies Bress. A wielder whose slashing or piercing weapon struck the fatal blow must pass a DC 15 Reflex save or leave that weapon trapped until the stone crumbles in 1d4 minutes.
builds.tactics: Bress takes the narrow end of the ramp. After warning intruders once, he fights with his shield up and glides down to the lower landing if forced off the edge.

concepts.name: Orruk Hollowtusk
concepts.motive: Keep his clan’s fish racks accessible through the thaw.
concepts.hook: A supply sledge blocks the shallow crossing. Orruk wants it pulled clear before the water climbs over the runners.

concepts.name: Saltlistener
concepts.role: Guide for travelers crossing pack ice.
concepts.motive: Bring his guests safely to the far bank.
concepts.hook: Saltlistener lays two short sticks in an X on the snow. The old crossing has cracked and he is trying to point out the safer route.

concepts.name: Bress Tarn
concepts.role: Baaz guard at a quarry landing.
concepts.motive: Keep the lower ramp clear while the last work crew climbs out.
concepts.hook: A quarry bell has fallen silent. Bress needs someone to reach the lower landing and find out why.
